pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed dark regions with jagged perimeters and non-geometric edges. Pixel-level gradients at patch boundaries are soft, exacerbated by horizontal motion blur across the mid-section. Patch area decreases in scale from the upper cervical region toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological lattice. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness, narrowing at junction nodes. Continuity is maintained throughout the visible torso, though contrast is lower in the rear haunch region due to blur.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Serrated 1D geometric contour of the mane along the dorsal ridge. The silhouette exhibits a high-frequency jagged profile with moderate amplitude created by distinct tufts of erect hair against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Multiple dark, circular focal points of hyper-pigmented textural disruption are visible within the darker patches on the cervical and mid-flank regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of two avian organisms (oxpeckers) positioned on the dorsal-lateral surface: one on the upper neck and one on the posterior haunch.
